decisions.quote: However, our study failed to replicate Boffo et al. (2018) findings in a Canadian sample.
decisions.location: Abstract, lines 83-84 (see also Section 5.1 Conclusion, lines 1079-1084)
decisions.reason: The authors state an explicit overall verdict in the abstract, discussion closing, and conclusion that the study failed to replicate Boffo et al. (2018), as all tested hypotheses regarding gambling approach bias and its concurrent and longitudinal associations failed. The discussion's passing remark that across-the-board null results incidentally matched the original's null findings on two secondary regression outcomes (PGSI and expenditure) does not outweigh the authors' overall failure verdict.
